summary: Logan Salviano, 25, a Vail resident and Two Elk Lodge employee, went missing while snowboarding at Vail Mountain on Tuesday; Vail ski patrol found his body Thursday in a tree well off an expert run on the mountain's front side near Chairs 3 and 4; the Eagle County coroner pronounced him dead and the sheriff's office ruled the death non-criminal, with autopsy pending
location: Vail Mountain, front side, off expert run near Chairs 3 and 4
responding_agency: Vail ski patrol; Eagle County Sheriff's Office / Eagle County Coroner
